claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings, targeting plateau pressure <30 cmH2O and appropriate PEEP.
Continue sedation with midazolam and fentanyl infusions, titrating to Richmond-RAS goal of -1.
Monitor core temperature closely and initiate fever workup if temperature remains elevated.
Obtain cultures and consider broad-spectrum antibiotics if infection is suspected.
Recheck serum potassium and initiate treatment for hyperkalemia if persistently elevated.
Monitor hemoglobin and hematocrit; consider transfusion if hemoglobin falls below 7 g/dL or if clinically indicated.
Monitor blood glucose and manage with insulin sliding scale as needed.
Perform daily sedation interruption and spontaneous breathing trial assessment when clinically appropriate.
Provide stress ulcer prophylaxis and venous thromboembolism prophylaxis as indicated.
Maintain head of bed elevation and subglottic suctioning to prevent ventilator-associated pneumonia.
